title: Topic to AI short video to posts

budget_usd.label: Most to spend on voice and video generation (USD)

tiktok_privacy.label: TikTok privacy: PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE, or SELF_ONLY until TikTok audits your app

steps.title: Plan the topic search
steps.prompt:
Niche: {{inputs.niche}}

Write {{run.dir}}/plan.md with six search angles for rising topics in this niche, each on its own line as search: <query>. Do not search yet.

steps.title: Pick three topics
steps.prompt: Sources: {{run.dir}}/sources/. Pick three topics for this niche: {{inputs.niche}}. Each needs a saved source and an angle nobody in the sources has taken. Write {{run.dir}}/topics.md.

steps.title: Write the scripts
steps.prompt: For each topic in {{run.dir}}/topics.md write a 30 to 45 second script: hook in the first 2 seconds, one idea, a call to action. Split each into beats with a visual prompt per beat. Write {{run.dir}}/script-0.md to script-2.md and an estimate of the voice and video generation cost in {{run.dir}}/cost.md. Set cost_usd to the total.

steps.title: Approve the voiceover spend
steps.gate_summary: Scripts: {{run.dir}}/script-0.md to script-2.md. Estimated total cost {{steps.script.outputs.cost_usd}} USD against a cap of {{inputs.budget_usd}}. Approve to generate the three voiceovers.

steps.title: Generate the voiceovers
steps.prompt: Generate a voiceover for each of {{run.dir}}/script-0.md to script-2.md with the text to speech service. Save {{run.dir}}/audio/voice-0.mp3 to voice-2.mp3. Set spent_usd to what it cost.

steps.title: Approve the video spend
steps.gate_summary: Voiceovers cost {{steps.voice.outputs.spent_usd}} USD. Approve to generate the scene clips for every beat in the three scripts, within {{inputs.budget_usd}} USD in total.

steps.title: Generate the scene clips
steps.prompt: For every beat in {{run.dir}}/script-0.md to script-2.md, generate a 9:16 scene clip from its visual prompt with the video generation service. Save them in {{run.dir}}/clips/<script>-<beat>.mp4. Set spent_usd to what it cost.

steps.title: Assemble the videos
steps.prompt: With ffmpeg, assemble three 9:16 videos from {{run.dir}}/clips/ and {{run.dir}}/audio/: clips in beat order, the voiceover on top, captions burned in from the script, the hook as an overlay in the first 2 seconds. Save {{run.dir}}/videos/short-0.mp4 to short-2.mp4.

steps.title: Write the posts
steps.prompt: For each video in {{run.dir}}/videos/ and each of tiktok, youtube-shorts and instagram-reels, write a title, caption and hashtags, and a posting slot in the week from {{inputs.week_start}} as ISO with the Sydney offset. Write {{run.dir}}/posts.json as a list of {clip (the mp4 path), platform, title (2 to 100 characters), caption, hashtags (list, no #), slot} and set the output key posts to that path.

steps.title: Check the videos
steps.prompt: Sample frames from every video in {{run.dir}}/videos/. Check captions sit inside each platform's safe zone and match the audio, no blank or broken frames, and the hook lands in the first 2 seconds. Write {{run.dir}}/check.md. Set passed to true when nothing is wrong, and list each problem with video and time under flags.

steps.title: Approve the posts
steps.gate_summary: Watch {{run.dir}}/videos/. Posts: {{steps.copy.outputs.posts}}. Check flags: {{steps.check.outputs.flags}}. Approve to schedule every post in one batch.
